Highlights
IRS launches new mobile app, expanding digital services for taxpayers
IR-2026-114, Sept. 25, 2026 — The IRS today announced the launch of the new IRS mobile app, replacing IRS2Go and expanding the agency’s digital services to give taxpayers more ways to securely access IRS tools and account services from their mobile devices.
Latest news releases
IRS reminder: Year-round tax planning can make filing easier
IR-2026-128, Oct. 23, 2026 — The Internal Revenue Service today encouraged taxpayers to take simple steps now to make filing easier and avoid tax-time surprises next year.
Treasury, IRS update retirement plan correction program and establish correction program for individual retirement accounts
IR-2026-126, Oct. 22, 2026 — The Department of the Treasury and the Internal Revenue Service today issued two revenue procedures that update the correction program for employee retirement plans and create one for Individual Retirement Accounts.
IRS reminder: Take steps now to protect tax information
IR-2026-127, Oct. 22, 2026 — The Internal Revenue Service today reminded taxpayers to protect their information from tax-related identity theft by safeguarding their IRS online-account credentials and obtaining an Identity Protection PIN.
Temporary reporting and recordkeeping relief for certain fuel uses
IR-2026-125, Oct. 21, 2026 — The Internal Revenue Service today announced temporary administrative relief from reporting and recordkeeping requirements relating to taxes imposed by section 4041(a) of the Internal Revenue Code.
IRS has begun issuing automatic refunds to individuals who claimed Adoption Tax Credit carryforward from prior years
IR-2026-123, Oct. 16, 2026 — The Internal Revenue Service has already begun issuing refunds to more than 50,000 taxpayers who benefited from the adoption tax credit carryforward and expects the refund process for most eligible taxpayers to be complete by the end of the year.
IRS announces 2026 Tax Professional Awareness Week, highlighting resources to help tax professionals prepare for the 2027 filing season
IR-2026-124, Oct. 16, 2026 — The Internal Revenue Service today announced Tax Professional Awareness Week, taking place the week of October 19th, which will feature webinars and practical tools to help tax professionals prepare for the upcoming filing season, support accurate tax return preparations and protect taxpayer information.

Treasury and IRS move to protect health care benefits for eligible Americans
IR-2026-121, Oct. 14, 2026 — The U.S. Department of the Treasury and the Internal Revenue Service issued proposed regulations to implement President Trump’s Working Families Tax Cuts reforms to the Premium Tax Credit (PTC), a refundable tax credit that helps eligible American taxpayers afford health insurance purchased through the Health Insurance Exchanges.
IRS provides dyed diesel fuel relief related to excise tax following President Trump’s Executive Order
IR-2026-122, Oct. 14, 2026 — The Internal Revenue Service today announced that, in response to the President’s Oct. 5, 2026, Executive Order, Emergency Tax Relief on Diesel Fuel, it will not impose a penalty when dyed diesel fuel is sold for use or used on highways nationwide.
